data.title: Regulation of TORC1 by Rag GTPases in nutrient response
data.authors: Kim E; Goraksha-Hicks P; Li L; Neufeld TP; Guan KL

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Rag GTPases mediate amino-acid signalling to TORC1 (parallel discovery to Sancak 2008).
data.abstract_excerpt: TORC1 (target of rapamycin complex 1) has a crucial role in the regulation of cell growth and size. A wide range of signals, including amino acids, is known to activate TORC1. Here, we report the identification of Rag GTPases as activators of TORC1 in response to amino acid signals. Knockdown of Rag gene expression suppressed the stimulatory effect of amino acids on TORC1 in Drosophila melanogaster S2 cells.

extracted_findings.effect: Rag GTPases activate TORC1 in response to amino-acid signals
